test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Opaque
solution: The correct answer is '**Clear**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Opaque**' is '**Clear**'. • **Opaque**: that you cannot see through. (अपारदर्शी) • *Example: **opaque** glass in the door...* • **Clear**: easy to see, hear or understand. (देखने, सुनने या समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़) • *Example: His voice wasn’t very **clear** on the telephone.* **Correct Answer:__** *Clear.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Dense**: containing a lot of things or people close together. (घनीभूत, बहुत-सी वस्‍तुओं या व्‍यक्तियों के जुटाव वाला) • **Misty**: full of, covered with, or accompanied by mist. (भरा हुआ, ढका हुआ, या धुंध के साथ) • **Hazy**: not clear, especially because of heat. [धुंधभरा, अस्‍पष्‍ट (विशेषतः ताप या गरमी के कारण)] 273:T992, The correct answer is '**compassionate**'.
